title: CarPlay file repair (CEBEP)
description: Only for cars where CarPlay file check (CEBEP) answered REPAIRABLE with res-safe1 / res-safe2. Puts the shipped safe-area bytes back into the CarPlay 22.28.3 file after the old cluster-yandex-safearea-fix, so Maps on cluster 0.11.0+ can patch again. Writes only when the result is the shipped file by SHA-256; in every other case it refuses and changes nothing. After install: restart the head unit, press Patch in Maps on cluster, then this tool can be removed.
